outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E histology image and spatial transcriptomic expression maps (heatmap-style overlays on tissue), not a plot of averaged/summary data requiring individual data points.
Panel B consists of micrographs (H&E and RNAscope fluorescence images), not a summary plot; individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual patient tumor value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and 95% CI overlaid, so individual data points are already displayed.
Panel D is a bar chart of qRT-PCR data (mean ± SD) with individual replicate data points (n=3) overlaid as dots for each group.
